lede: Everything here is judged for **one person, paying their own way**. A tool that is excellent for a funded team can still land in Hold.

rings.adopt: Proven in real use. A default choice.
rings.trial: Actively being tried on a real project.
rings.hold: Doesn't fit solo work — reason recorded on each tool.

ringNote: Adopt and Trial describe **experience**. Assess and Hold describe **research**. Nothing is promoted by being researched, so every new tool starts at Assess however good it looks.

items: Only a problem at org scale
Free tier too thin to ship on

rubricNote: Hold is not a verdict on quality. It records that the economics don't fit one person.
dial: Sectors are **problems to solve**, not vendor categories.
Distance from the centre is the ring.
A tool sits in **every area it serves**, so one tool can be several dots.
Position inside a band is packing only — it means nothing.
excludedNote: Absence usually just means not researched yet.
